observations: Large executive office desk with a dark wood-grain finish on the top and side panels.
The front panel has a light-colored textured finish with a dark rectangular center piece.
Warm LED lighting is visible behind the dark center piece on the front.
An integrated side cabinet or pedestal is attached to the left side.
A rectangular cable management grommet is visible on the desktop.
The photo background shows a furniture showroom environment with other desks and shelving.
Watermark 'DANTEX FURNITURE' is present across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: Requires physical measurement with a tape measure.

risks.proof: A video showing the lights being switched on and off.

risks.risk: Internal condition of the side cabinet and drawers is unknown.
risks.proof: Photos of the cabinet and drawers fully open.
risks.if_unproven: as having damaged or missing internal shelves/runners

risks.risk: Surface material may be low-grade particle board rather than high-density fiberboard or solid wood.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of an unfinished edge or the underside.

proof_requests: Video of the LED lights being operated.
Photos of the interior of the side cabinet and any drawers.
Photo of the desk with a measuring tape showing the 1.6m length.
Photos of the back of the desk to check for finishing and damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a modern executive desk. While it appears to be a showroom photo, it can be priced as a standard unit of this type, with the LED and internal storage priced at worst-case until proven functional.
